purpose: Engine-neutral source preflight and staging gate; this file is not a training corpus or training authorization.
repository_access: Public Git repository; clone the canonical repository and read the manifests listed below.

source_groups.rights_and_review_status: The saved LOC item metadata records the books as public domain and free to use and reuse, but the canonical inventory and provenance manifest still record PENDING_REVIEW and training_eligible=false. Preserve that status; do not auto-ingest or treat the books as training-approved until the existing review record is formally resolved.
source_groups.technical_provenance: See data/training_sources/public_domain/english/provenance-manifest.json and the original SHA256SUMS.txt. Existing paths, records, and hashes are not changed by this update.

conditions: Provide O*NET attribution and indicate changes.
Scope is limited to the three named tables in source-inventory.json.
Keep source URLs and original paths.
The prior assessment notes possible third-party verbatim material; escalate any identified item rather than treating CC0 as a cure for third-party rights.

source_groups.license: CC0-1.0 for the bounded Wikidata Lexeme structured-data namespace
conditions: Preserve Lexeme, Form, and Sense IDs, language codes, statements, and source references.
Escalate any concrete third-party rights issue.
The upstream publisher checksum listing was unavailable; use the recorded local SHA-256 as the repository reference hash.

candidate_policy.default_for_new_sources: Only exact, scope-bounded public-domain or CC0 material may be considered for addition under the current user preference.
candidate_policy.noaa_nws_glossary: Exclude. It is only a public-domain candidate; the A page was sampled but the remaining linked numeric/B-Z pages were not checked.
candidate_policy.other_reviewed_candidates: Excluded from content inputs or metadata-only because the exact material is copyrighted, mixed-source, unresolved, or not shown to be PD/CC0.

consumer_requirements: Read each source's NOTICE, license evidence, revision, path scope, and caveats in source-inventory.json before processing.
Do not infer model-training approval from redistribution permission, public availability, or staging eligibility.
Do not set training_status to approved without a separate source-specific content and training-suitability review.
Preserve provenance IDs, upstream references, applicable attribution, and the recorded SHA-256 values.
No Full-Build inputs or workflows are changed by this source-repository update.
